question.en: What does a circular blue command sign displaying a truck next to '80' or 'L' (Sign R102-L) require?
question.af: Wat vereis 'n ronde blou bevelbord met 'n vragmotor langs '80' of 'L' (Teken R102-L)?
question.xh: Yintoni efunwa luphawu olujikelezileyo oluluhlaza lomyalelo olubonisa ilori ecaleni kuka-'80' okanye u-'L' (Uphawu R102-L)?
question.zu: Yini efunwa uphawu oluyindilinga oluluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka lomyalo olubonisa ilori eceleni kuka-'80' noma u-'L' (Uphawu R102-L)?
question.st: Ke eng se hlokwang ke sesupo se sebolo se putsoa sa taelo se bontshang lori haufi le '80' kapa 'L' (Sesupo R102-L)?
question.tn: Ke eng se se batlwang ke letshwao le le dikologileng le lo lo putsu la taelo le le bontshang lori gaufi le '80' kgotsa 'L' (Letshwao R102-L)?

en.A: A) Mandatory command for heavy vehicles to engage low gear.
en.B: B) Maximum speed limit of 80 km/h.
en.C: C) Warning of steep hill ahead.

af.A: A) Verpligte bevel vir swaar voertuie om lae rat te skakel.
af.C: C) Waarskuwing van steil bult vorentoe.

xh.A: A) Umyalelo onyanzelekileyo kwizithuthi ezisindayo wokufaka igiya elisezantsi.
xh.B: B) Umda ophezulu wesantya i-80 km/h.

zu.A: A) Umyalo ophoqelekile wezimoto ezisindayo ukuthi zifake igiya eliphansi.

st.A: A) Taelo e qobelletsweng ho dikoloi tse boima ho kenya giya e tlase.
st.B: B) Lebelo le phahameng la 80 km/h.
st.C: C) Temoso ya thaba e maotwana pele.

tn.A: A) Taelo e e patelesegang go dikoloi tse di boima go tsenya gia e e kwa tlase.
tn.B: B) Lobelo lo lo kwa godimo lwa 80 km/h.
tn.C: C) Temoso ya thaba e e maotoana kwa pele.

explanation.en: Sign R102-L mandates that heavy vehicle drivers shift into low gear before steep descents.
explanation.af: Teken R102-L vereis dat swaarvoertuigbestuurders na 'n lae rat oorskakel voor steil afdraande.
explanation.xh: Uphawu R102-L luyalela ukuba abaqhubi bezithuthi ezisindayo batshintshele kwigiya elisezantsi phambi kokuhla intaba enkulu.
explanation.zu: Uphawu R102-L luphoqa ukuthi abashayeli bezimoto ezisindayo bafake igiya eliphansi ngaphambi kokwehla intaba.
explanation.st: Sesupo R102-L se laela hore bakgweli ba dikoloi tse boima ba fetohele giya e tlase pele ba theoha dithaba tse maotwana.
explanation.tn: Letshwao R102-L le laela gore bakgweetsi ba dikoloi tse di boima ba fetogele mo giaring e e kwa tlase pele ba fologa dithaba tse di maotoana.

questions.code_name: Code 3 - Heavy Motor Vehicles (Code 10/14 / Class C/EC)

question.en: In the heavy vehicle cockpit diagram, what is the primary function of the exhaust brake / engine retarder?
question.af: In die swaarvoertuig-stuurkajuitdiagram, wat is die primêre funksie van die uitlaatrem / enjinvertrager?
question.xh: Kwidayagram yekhabhini yesithuthi esisindayo, yintoni umsebenzi ophambili webhreki yomsi / isithintelo senjini?
question.zu: Kudiyagremu yekhabhini yemoto esindayo, yini umsebenzi oyinhloko webhuleki lomshiso/isivimbi senjini?
question.st: Ho diagram ya khabine ya koloi e boima, ke eng mosebetsi wa mantlha wa boreka ba mosi / sethibi sa enjine?
question.tn: Mo dayakeromong ya khabo ya koloi e e boima, ke eng tiro e kgolo ya boreka jwa mosi / sethibi sa enjene?

en.A: A) Assists in slowing the heavy vehicle down steep hills without overheating service brakes.

af.A: A) Help om die swaar voertuig op steil bulte te vertraag sonder om diensremme te oorverhit.
af.B: B) Verhoog die enjin se versnellingspoed.
af.C: C) Skakel die koppelaar outomaties los.

xh.A: A) Inceda ekucotheni isithuthi esisindayo ezintabeni ezinkulu ngaphandle kokushisa kakhulu iibhreki zenkonzo.

zu.A: A) Lusiza ekwehliseni isivinini semoto esindayo ezintabeni ezinkulu ngaphandle kokushisisa amabhuleki omsebenzi.

st.A: A) Se thusa ho fokotsa lebelo la koloi e boima dithabeng tse maotwana ntle le ho chesa boreka ba tshebeletso.
st.B: B) Se eketsa lebelo la ho akgehla ha enjine.
st.C: C) Se lokolla clutch ka boyona.

tn.A: A) E thusa go fokotsa lobelo lwa koloi e e boima mo dithoteng tse di maotoana kwa ntle ga go chesa boreka jwa tirelo.
tn.B: B) E oketsa lobelo lwa go akofisa lwa enjene.
tn.C: C) E lokolola kelase ka boyona.

explanation.en: Exhaust/engine brakes provide supplementary deceleration, preserving air service brakes on steep descents.
explanation.af: Uitlaat-/enjinremme verskaf bykomende vertraging, wat lugdiensremme op steil afdraandes bespaar.
explanation.xh: Iibhreki zomsi/zenjini zinika ukucotha okongezelelweyo, zigcina iibhreki zomoya zenkonzo ezintabeni ezinkulu.
explanation.zu: Amabhuleki omshiso/enjini anikeza ukwehla kwesivinini okwengeziwe, egcina amabhuleki omoya omsebenzi ezintabeni ezinkulu.
explanation.st: Boreka ba mosi/enjine bo fana ka ho fokotsa lebelo ho eketsehileng, bo boloka boreka ba moya ba tshebeletso dithabeng tse maotwana.
explanation.tn: Boreka jwa mosi/enjene bo naya go fokotsa lobelo go go oketsegileng, bo boloka boreka jwa moya jwa tirelo mo dithoteng tse di maotoana.

question.xh: Yintoni umda osemthethweni wotywala egazini kubaqhubi abangoosomabhizinisi abaqhuba izithuthi ezisindayo (abanePrDP)?

question.xh: Sisiphi isixhobo sesilumkiso esilumkisa umqhubi ukuba uxinzelelo lwebhreki yomoya yesithuthi esisindayo luwa phantsi ngokuyingozi?

question.en: What does a rectangular sign displaying 'ESCAPE RAMP' or an ascending gravel bed (Sign IN11) indicate?
question.af: Wat dui 'n reghoekige bord met 'ONTSNAPHELLING' of 'n opgaande gruisbed (Teken IN11) aan?
question.xh: Yintoni ebonisa luphawu olungunxande olubonisa 'ESCAPE RAMP' okanye umgca wamatye onyukayo (Uphawu IN11)?
question.zu: Yini ekhonjiswa uphawu olulisikwele elibonisa 'ESCAPE RAMP' noma umbhede wamatshana okhuphukayo (Uphawu IN11)?
question.st: Ke eng se bontshwang ke sesupo se hlangothi tse nne se nang le 'ESCAPE RAMP' kapa mmele wa majwe o nyollohang (Sesupo IN11)?
question.tn: Ke eng se se bontshiwang ke letshwao la khutlonnetlha la 'ESCAPE RAMP' kgotsa mobu wa matlapa o o rotogang (Letshwao IN11)?

en.B: B) Highway exit for rest stop.

af.A: A) Vangbed vorentoe vir swaar voertuie wat beheer verloor het.

xh.A: A) Umgca wokubamba ngaphambili wezithuthi ezisindayo ezingasekho phantsi kolawulo.
xh.B: B) Ukuphuma kwendlela enkulu kwindawo yokuphumla.

zu.A: A) Umbhede wokubamba ngaphambili wezimoto ezisindayo ezingasenawo ukulawuleka.

st.A: A) Mmele wa ho tshwara ka pele bakeng sa dikoloi tse boima tse se nang taolo.
st.B: B) Ho tswa ha tsela e kgolo bakeng sa phomolo.
st.C: C) Seteishene sa ho hlahloba sekala sa boima.

tn.B: B) Go tswa ga tsela e kgolo bakeng sa boikhutso.
tn.C: C) Seteisēne sa go sekaseka sekala sa bokete.

explanation.xh: Uphawu IN11 lukhokela izithuthi ezisindayo eziwayo ngaphandle kolawulo ezineebhreki ezingasebenziyo kumgca wentlabathi/wamatye wokubamba.

explanation.tn: Letshwao IN11 le kaela dikoloi tse di boima tse di tswang mo taolong tse di nang le boreka jo bo paletsweng go tsena mo mobung wa mmu/matlapa wa go tshwara.

question.en: Before starting the engine of a heavy motor vehicle, what position must the gear lever (Control 6) be in?
question.af: Voordat die enjin van 'n swaar motorvoertuig gestart word, in watter posisie moet die rathefboom (Beheer 6) wees?
question.xh: Phambi kokuqalisa injini yesithuthi esisindayo, isixhobo segiya (Ulawulo 6) kufuneka sibe kwindawo ephi?
question.zu: Ngaphambi kokuqalisa injini yemoto esindayo, isilawuli segiya (Isilawuli 6) kufanele sibe kuyiphi indawo?
question.st: Pele o qala enjine ya koloi e boima, lever ya giya (Taolo 6) e tlameha ho ba maemong afe?
question.tn: Pele o simolola enjene ya koloi e e boima, lebole la gia (Taolo 6) le tshwanetse go nna mo maemong afe?

en.A: A) Neutral position.

af.A: A) Neutrale posisie.

xh.A: A) Indawo ephakathi (Neutral).

zu.A: A) Indawo ephakathi (Neutral).

st.A: A) Maemo a Neutral.
st.B: B) Giya ya pele.
st.C: C) Giya ya ho kgutlela morao.

tn.A: A) Boemo jwa Neutral.
tn.B: B) Gia ya ntlha.
tn.C: C) Gia ya go boela kwa morago.

explanation.en: The gear lever must be checked in Neutral before cranking the starter motor.
explanation.af: Die rathefboom moet in Neutraal nagegaan word voordat die selfstartmotor gedraai word.
explanation.xh: Isixhobo segiya kufuneka sihlolwe sikwiNeutral phambi kokujikeleza injini yokuqalisa.
explanation.zu: Isilawuli segiya kufanele sihlolwe sikwiNeutral ngaphambi kokuphenya injini yokuqalisa.
explanation.st: Lever ya giya e tlameha ho hlahlojwa e le ho Neutral pele ho fetoha enjine ya ho qala.
explanation.tn: Lebole la gia le tshwanetse go sekasekwa le le mo Neutral pele go sokamisiwa enjene ya go simolola.

question.en: What does a circular prohibition sign showing two trucks side-by-side (Sign R215) mean?
question.af: Wat beteken 'n ronde verbodsbord met twee vragmotors langs mekaar (Teken R215)?
question.xh: Yintoni ethethwa luphawu olujikelezileyo lokwalela olubonisa iilori ezimbini ecaleni komnye (Uphawu R215)?
question.zu: Yini eyisho uphawu oluyindilinga lokuvimbela olubonisa amalori amabili eceleni komunye (Uphawu R215)?
question.st: Ke eng se bolelwang ke sesupo se sebolo sa ho thibela se bontshang dilori tse pedi ka thoko le thoko (Sesupo R215)?
question.tn: Ke eng se se rayang letshwao le le dikologileng la go gana le le bontshang dilori tse pedi di le fa thoko le thoko (Letshwao R215)?

en.A: A) No Overtaking for goods vehicles.
en.B: B) Heavy vehicles must drive in pairs.

af.A: A) Geen Verbygaan vir goederevoertuie nie.
af.B: B) Swaar voertuie moet in pare ry.

xh.A: A) Akukho Kudlula kwizithuthi zempahla.
xh.B: B) Izithuthi ezisindayo kufuneka ziqhube ngazibini.

zu.A: A) Akukho Ukudlula kwezimoto zempahla.
zu.B: B) Izimoto ezisindayo kufanele zihambe ngambili ngambili.

st.A: A) Ha ho Feta bakeng sa dikoloi tsa thepa.
st.B: B) Dikoloi tse boima di tlameha ho tsamaya ka bobedi bobedi.
st.C: C) Tsela ya mebila e mmedi bakeng sa dilori.

tn.A: A) Ga go na go Feta bakeng sa dikoloi tsa dithoto.
tn.B: B) Dikoloi tse di boima di tshwanetse go tsamaya ka bobedi.
tn.C: C) Tsela ya mebila e mebedi bakeng sa dilori.

explanation.en: Sign R215 prohibits goods vehicles from overtaking any moving vehicle on that section of road.
explanation.af: Teken R215 verbied goederevoertuie om enige bewegende voertuig op daardie gedeelte van die pad verby te steek.
explanation.xh: Uphawu R215 luthintela izithuthi zempahla ekudluleni naliphi na isithuthi esihambayo kwelo candelo lendlela.
explanation.zu: Uphawu R215 luvimbela izimoto zempahla ekudluleni noma yisiphi isimoto esihambayo kuleyo ngxenye yomgwaqo.
explanation.st: Sesupo R215 se thibela dikoloi tsa thepa ho feta koloi efe kapa efe e tsamayang karolong eo ya tsela.
explanation.tn: Letshwao R215 le gana dikoloi tsa dithoto go feta koloi epe fela e e tsamayang mo karolong eo ya tsela.

questions.code_name: Code 3 - Heavy Motor Vehicles (Code 10/14 / Class C/EC)

question.en: What is the minimum safe following distance recommended for heavy motor vehicles in normal driving conditions?
question.af: Wat is die minimum veilige volgafstand aanbeveel vir swaar motorvoertuie onder normale bestuurstoestande?
question.xh: Bubuphi umgama okhuselekileyo osezantsi ocetyiswayo wokulandela kwizithuthi ezisindayo kwiimeko eziqhelekileyo zokuqhuba?
question.zu: Yibuphi ibanga eliphephile eliphansi elincomekile lokulandela lemoto esindayo ngaphansi kwezimo ezijwayelekile zokushayela?
question.st: Ke bofe bokgole bo sireletsehileng bo tlase bo kgothaletswang ba ho latela bakeng sa dikoloi tse boima maemong a tlwaelehileng a ho kgweletsa?
question.tn: Ke sekgala sefe se se babalesegileng se se kwa tlase se se kgothaledisiwang sa go latela bakeng sa dikoloi tse di boima mo maemong a a tlwaelegileng a go kgweetsa?

en.A: A) At least 3 to 4 seconds (or 1 second per 3m of vehicle length).

af.A: A) Ten minste 3 tot 4 sekondes (of 1 sekonde per 3m voertuiglengte).

xh.A: A) Ubuncinane imizuzwana emi-3 ukuya kwemi-4 (okanye umzuzwana omnye kwiimitha ezi-3 zobude besithuthi).

zu.A: A) Okungenani imizuzwana emi-3 kuya kwemi-4 (noma umzuzwana owodwa ngamamitha ayi-3 obude bemoto).

st.A: A) Bonyane metsotswana e 3 ho isa ho 4 (kapa motsotswana o le mong ho di-3m tsa botelele ba koloi).
st.B: B) Metsotswana e 2.
st.C: C) Motsotswana o le mong.

tn.A: A) Bonnyennyennye metsotswana e le 3 go ya go 4 (kgotsa motsotswana o le mongwe go 3m ya boleele jwa koloi).
tn.B: B) Metsotswana e le 2.
tn.C: C) Motsotswana o le mongwe.

explanation.en: Heavy vehicles require an extended following distance of 3 to 4 seconds due to longer braking distances.
explanation.af: Swaar voertuie benodig 'n verlengde volgafstand van 3 tot 4 sekondes weens langer remafstande.
explanation.xh: Izithuthi ezisindayo zifuna umgama olandelayo owelulekiweyo weemizuzwana emi-3 ukuya kwemi-4 ngenxa yemigama emide yokumisa.
explanation.zu: Izimoto ezisindayo zidinga ibanga elandelayo elelulekile lemizuzwana emi-3 kuya kwemi-4 ngenxa yamabanga amade okumisa.
explanation.st: Dikoloi tse boima di hloka bokgole bo eketsehileng ba ho latela ba metsotswana e 3 ho isa ho 4 ka lebaka la dibaka tse telele tsa ho ema.
explanation.tn: Dikoloi tse di boima di tlhoka sekgala se se oketsegileng sa go latela sa metsotswana e le 3 go ya go 4 ka ntlha ya dikgala tse di telele tsa go ema.

question.st: Ke sefe sepalo se phahameng se dumelletsweng sa maqhubu a tokiso a pele nakong ya boitshwaro ba ho kena sebakeng se moqotwana koloing e hokahaneng ya Khoutu EC?
question.tn: Ke palo efe e kgolo e e letleletsweng ya matshikinyego a tokiso a fa pele mo tirong ya go tsena mo lefelong le lesesane mo koloing e e kgokagantsweng ya Khoutu EC?

en.A: A) Maximum of 2 forward correction movements.

af.A: A) Maksimum van 2 voorwaartse regstellingsbewegings.

zu.A: A) Okuphakeme kokunyakaza okubili kokulungisa okuya phambili.

st.A: A) Boholo ba maqhubu a mabedi a tokiso a pele.
st.B: B) Maqhubu a se nang moedi.
st.C: C) Ha ho tokiso e dumelletsweng.

tn.A: A) Bontsi jwa matshikinyego a le mabedi a tokiso a fa pele.
tn.B: B) Matshikinyego a a se nang selekanyo.

question.en: What is the maximum overall length permitted for a rigid heavy goods vehicle on a public road?
question.af: Wat is die maksimum algehele lengte toegelaat vir 'n stywe swaar goederevoertuig op 'n openbare pad?
question.xh: Bubuphi ubude obupheleleyo obuvumelekileyo kwisithuthi esiqinileyo esisindayo sempahla kwindlela yoluntu?
question.zu: Yibuphi ubude obuphelele obuvunyelwe kumoto eqinile esindayo yempahla emgwaqeni womphakathi?
question.st: Ke bofe botelele bo felletseng bo dumelletsweng bakeng sa koloi e thata e boima ya thepa tseleng ya setjhaba?
question.tn: Ke bogolo bofe jotlhe jo bo letleletsweng bakeng sa koloi e e thata e e boima ya dithoto mo tseleng ya setshaba?

en.A: A) 12.5 metres.

af.A: A) 12.5 meter.

xh.A: A) Iimitha ezi-12.5.

zu.A: A) Amamitha ayi-12.5.

st.A: A) Dimithara tse 12.5.
st.B: B) Dimithara tse 15.0.
st.C: C) Dimithara tse 18.5.

tn.A: A) Dimetara tse 12.5.
tn.B: B) Dimetara tse 15.0.
tn.C: C) Dimetara tse 18.5.

explanation.en: A rigid goods vehicle (single chassis) has a maximum overall length limit of 12.5 metres (18.5m for combinations).
explanation.af: 'n Stywe goederevoertuig (enkelchassis) het 'n maksimum algehele lengtebeperking van 12.5 meter (18.5m vir kombinasies).
explanation.xh: Isithuthi esiqinileyo sempahla (ishasi elinye) sinomda wobude obupheleleyo ophezulu weemitha ezi-12.5 (i-18.5m kwimifuziselo).
explanation.zu: Imoto eqinile yempahla (ishasi elilodwa) inomkhawulo wobude obuphelele obuphakeme ongamamitha ayi-12.5 (ama-18.5m ezinhlanganiselo).
explanation.st: Koloi e thata ya thepa (chassis e le nngwe) e na le moedi wa botelele bo felletseng bo phahameng ba dimithara tse 12.5 (18.5m bakeng sa dikopanyo).
explanation.tn: Koloi e e thata ya dithoto (chassis e le nngwe) e na le molelwane wa boleele jotlhe jo bo kwa godimo jwa dimetara tse 12.5 (18.5m bakeng sa dikopano).

question.en: During Module 1 interior pre-trip inspection, how long must air pressure hold steady without dropping after switching off the engine with brakes applied?
question.af: Tydens die Module 1-binnehofpretrit-inspeksie, hoe lank moet lugdruk stabiel bly sonder om te daal nadat die enjin afgeskakel is met remme toegepas?
question.xh: Ngexesha lohlolo lwangaphakathi lweModyuli 1 phambi kohambo, uxinzelelo lomoya kufuneka luhlale luzinzile ixesha elingakanani ngaphandle kokuwa emva kokucima injini iibhreki zisebenza?
question.zu: Ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa kwangaphakathi kweModyuli 1 ngaphambi kohambo, ingcindezi yomoya kufanele ihlale izinzile isikhathi esingakanani ngaphandle kokwehla ngemva kokucisha injini namabhuleki efakwe?
question.st: Nakong ya tlhahlobo ya ka hare ya Module 1 pele ho leeto, khatello ya moya e tlameha ho dula e tsitsitse hakae ntle le ho theoha kamora ho tima enjine ha boreka bo sebediswa?
question.tn: Mo nakong ya tlhatlhobo ya mo teng ya Module 1 pele ga loeto, kgatelelo ya moya e tshwanetse go nna e nitame nako e e kae kwa ntle ga go wa fa enjene e timilwe ka boreka bo dirisiwa?

en.A: A) Air pressure must remain stable without audible leaks for at least 1 minute.

af.A: A) Lugdruk moet stabiel bly sonder hoorbare lekkasies vir ten minste 1 minuut.

xh.A: A) Uxinzelelo lomoya kufuneka luhlale luzinzile ngaphandle kokuvuza okuvakalayo ubuncinane umzuzu omnye.

zu.A: A) Ingcindezi yomoya kufanele ihlale izinzile ngaphandle kokuvuza okuzwakalayo okungenani umzuzu owodwa.

st.A: A) Khatello ya moya e tlameha ho dula e tsitsitse ntle le ho dutla ho utlwahalang bonyane motsotso o le mong.
st.B: B) Metsotso e 5.
st.C: C) Metsotswana e 10.

tn.A: A) Kgatelelo ya moya e tshwanetse go nna e nitame kwa ntle ga go dutla go go utlwalang bonnye motsotso o le mongwe.
tn.B: B) Metsotso e le 5.
tn.C: C) Metsotswana e le 10.

explanation.en: Air brake leak check requires holding pressure for 1 minute with engine off to confirm system integrity.

explanation.xh: Uvavanyo lokuvuza kwebhreki yomoya lufuna ukubamba uxinzelelo umzuzu omnye injini icinyiwe ukuqinisekisa ubuqotho benkqubo.
explanation.zu: Ukuhlolwa kokuvuza kwebhuleki lomoya kudinga ukubamba ingcindezi umzuzu owodwa ngenjini icimile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ubuqotho besistimu.
explanation.st: Tlhahlobo ya ho dutla ha boreka ba moya e hloka ho tshwara khatello motsotso o le mong ha enjine e timile ho netefatsa botshepehi ba tsamaiso.

question.en: What does a circular sign displaying '8t' over an axle diagram (Sign R203) indicate?

question.xh: Yintoni ebonisa luphawu olujikelezileyo olubonisa u-'8t' ngaphezulu kwedayagram ye-aksi (Uphawu R203)?
question.zu: Yini ekhonjiswa uphawu oluyindilinga olubonisa u-'8t' ngaphezulu kwediyagremu ye-akse (Uphawu R203)?
question.st: Ke eng se bontshwang ke sesupo se sebolo se bontshang '8t' hodima diagram ya aksele (Sesupo R203)?

explanation.en: Sign R203 restricts the maximum allowable load bearing on any single axle or axle unit to 8 tonnes.
explanation.af: Teken R203 beperk die maksimum toelaatbare vrag op enige enkele as of aseenheid tot 8 ton.
explanation.xh: Uphawu R203 luthintela umthwalo omkhulu ovunyelweyo kwi-aksi enye okanye iyunithi ye-aksi ukuya kutsho kwiitoni ezi-8.
explanation.zu: Uphawu R203 lukhawulela umthwalo omkhulu ovunyelwe ku-akse eyodwa noma iyunithi ye-akse kuze kufike ezinthonelweni eziyi-8.
explanation.st: Sesupo R203 se thibela mojaro o phahameng o dumelletsweng ho aksele e le nngwe kapa yuniti ya aksele ho fihla ditoneng tse 8.
explanation.tn: Letshwao R203 le gana morwalo o mogolo o o letleletsweng mo aekeseleng e le nngwe kgotsa yuniti ya aekesele go fitlha ditoneng tse 8.

question.en: What is the function of the trailer brake control lever (trolley valve / trailer supply valve) in a Code EC combination?
question.af: Wat is die funksie van die sleepwaboehefboom (trolleiklep / sleepwavoorsieningsklep) in 'n Kode EC-kombinasie?
question.xh: Yintoni umsebenzi wehandile yolawulo lwebhreki yetreyile (ivalve yetroli / ivalve yokubonelela itreyile) kwimifuziselo yeKhowudi EC?
question.zu: Yini umsebenzi wehandle lokulawula ibhuleki letreyila (ivalvu yetroli / ivalvu yokupha itreyila) enhlanganiseleni yeKhodi EC?
question.st: Ke eng mosebetsi wa lever ya taolo ya boreka ba terele (valve ya trolley / valve ya phepelo ya terele) kopanyong ya Khoutu EC?
question.tn: Ke eng tiro ya lebole la taolo ya boreka jwa thelele (vaalefe ya trolley / vaalefe ya go fepa thelele) mo kopanong ya Khoutu EC?

en.A: A) Applies trailer air brakes independently from truck tractor brakes.
en.B: B) Releases trailer parking spring brakes.

af.A: A) Pas sleepwa-lugremme onafhanklik van die trekker se remme toe.
af.C: C) Verstel die enjin se uitlaatrem.

xh.A: A) Isebenzisa iibhreki zomoya zetreyile ngokuzimela kwiibhreki zomqhubi-nqwelo.
xh.B: B) Ikhulula iibhreki zesprin zokupaka zetreyile.

zu.A: A) Isebenzisa amabhuleki omoya etreyila ngokuzimela kusuka kumabhuleki ethrakthara.
zu.B: B) Ikhulula amabhuleki wesipringi wokupaka etreyila.

st.A: A) E sebedisa boreka ba moya ba terele ka boikemelo ho tswa boreka ba tractor.
st.B: B) E lokolla boreka ba spring ba ho paka ba terele.
st.C: C) E lokisa boreka ba mosi wa enjine.

tn.A: A) E dirisa boreka jwa moya jwa thelele ka boipuso go tswa mo boreking jwa terekere.
tn.B: B) E lokolola boreka jwa sepirinye jwa go paka jwa thelele.
tn.C: C) E baakanya boreka jwa mosi wa enjene.

explanation.en: The trailer brake control valve operates trailer brakes independently to prevent jackknifing.
explanation.af: Die sleepwaremkontrole-klep bedien sleepwaremme onafhanklik om te verhoed dat die kombinasie insnoer.
explanation.xh: Ivalve yolawulo lwebhreki yetreyile isebenzisa iibhreki zetreyile ngokuzimela ukuthintela ukugoba njengengqingqa.
explanation.zu: Ivalvu yokulawula ibhuleki letreyila isebenzisa amabhuleki etreyila ngokuzimela ukuvimbela ukugoqeka.
explanation.st: Valve ya taolo ya boreka ba terele e sebedisa boreka ba terele ka boikemelo ho thibela ho mena jwaloka mokotla.
explanation.tn: Vaalefe ya taolo ya boreka jwa thelele e dirisa boreka jwa thelele ka boipuso go thibela go kobega jaaka thipa.

question.en: What check must be performed on the fifth wheel coupling during Module 2 exterior pre-trip inspection?
question.af: Watter kontrole moet op die vyfdewiel-koppeling uitgevoer word tydens die Module 2-buitekant-pretrit-inspeksie?
question.xh: Luluphi uvavanyo olufuneka lwenziwe kudibaniso lwevili lesihlanu ngexesha lohlolo lwangaphandle lweModyuli 2 phambi kohambo?
question.zu: Yikuphi ukuhlolwa okumele kwenziwe ekuxhumaneni kwesondo lesihlanu ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa kwangaphandle kweModyuli 2 ngaphambi kohambo?
question.st: Ke tlhahlobo efe e tlamehang ho etswa ho tlemano ya sesondo sa bohlano nakong ya tlhahlobo ya kantle ya Module 2 pele ho leeto?
question.tn: Ke tlhatlhobo efe e e tshwanetseng go dirwa mo kgokaganyong ya leotwana la boraro fa e le tlhano mo tlhatlhobong ya kwa ntle ya Module 2 pele ga loeto?

en.A: A) Verify locking jaw is fully engaged around kingpin, safety latch locked, and no gap between plate and apron.

af.A: A) Verifieer dat die sluitkake volledig om die koningspen gesluit is, veiligheidsgrendel gesluit is, en geen gaping tussen plaat en voorskoot is nie.

xh.A: A) Qinisekisa ukuba umhlathi wokutshixa ubambe ngokupheleleyo ngeenxa zonke ze-kingpin, isivalo sokhuseleko sitshixiwe, kwaye akukho sikhewu phakathi kwepleyiti nefaskoti.

zu.A: A) Qinisekisa ukuthi umhlathi wokukhiya ubambe ngokugcwele ngaphakathi kwe-kingpin, isivalo sokuphepha sikhiyiwe, futhi akukho sikhala phakathi kwepuleti ne-apron.

st.A: A) Netefatsa hore mohlahare wa notlolo o tshwere ka botlalo ho pota-pota kingpin, notlolo ya tshireletso e notletswe, mme ha ho sekgala pakeng tsa poleiti le epron.
st.B: B) Hlahloba khatello ya masondo.
st.C: C) Hlahloba maqhwa a sesuisi sa fensetere.

tn.A: A) Netefatsa gore lonoka lwa notlelo lo tshwere ka botlalo go dikologa kingpin, notlelo ya tshireletso e notletswe, mme ga go na sekgala magareng ga poleite le apone.
tn.B: B) Sekaseka kgatelelo ya ditayara.
tn.C: C) Sekaseka dikwathwana tsa seswibi sa fensetere.

explanation.en: Fifth wheel inspection requires verifying kingpin jaw engagement, safety catch position, and zero plate gap.
explanation.af: Vyfdewiel-inspeksie vereis verifiëring van koningspen-kaakomsluiting, veiligheidsgrendelposisie, en nul plaatgaping.
explanation.xh: Uhlolo lwevili lesihlanu lufuna ukuqinisekiswa kokubambeka komhlathi we-kingpin, indawo yesivalo sokhuseleko, nesikhewu esingumsobo sepleyiti.
explanation.zu: Ukuhlolwa kwesondo lesihlanu kudinga ukuqinisekiswa kokubambeka komhlathi we-kingpin, isikhundla sesivalo sokuphepha, nesikhala esiyize sepuleti.
explanation.st: Tlhahlobo ya sesondo sa bohlano e hloka ho netefatswa ha ho tshwarwa ha mohlahare wa kingpin, sebaka sa notlolo ya tshireletso, le sekgala sa poleiti se leqe.
explanation.tn: Tlhatlhobo ya leotwana la boraro fa e le tlhano e tlhoka go netefatsa go tshwarega ga lonoka lwa kingpin, boemo jwa notlelo ya tshireletso, le sekgala se se se yong sa poleite.

veteran_k53_examiner.xh: Nqanda Mfundi. Phantsi koMthetho wePhathelo yeeNdlela: Uhlolo lwevili lesihlanu lufuna ukuqinisekiswa kokubambeka komhlathi we-kingpin, indawo yesivalo sokhuseleko, nesikhewu esingumsobo sepleyiti. Ukungathobeli kukhokelela ekufeyileni.
veteran_k53_examiner.zu: Qaphela Mfundi. Ngaphansi komthetho womgwaqo: Ukuhlolwa kwesondo lesihlanu kudinga ukuqinisekiswa kokubambeka komhlathi we-kingpin, isikhundla sesivalo sokuphepha, nesikhala esiyize sepuleti. Ukungayithobeli kuholela ekuhlulekeni.
veteran_k53_examiner.st: Mametse Mokopi. Tlas'a Molao wa Tsela: Tlhahlobo ya sesondo sa bohlano e hloka ho netefatswa ha ho tshwarwa ha mohlahare wa kingpin, sebaka sa notlolo ya tshireletso, le sekgala sa poleiti se leqe. Ho se mamele ho lebisa ho hloleheng.
veteran_k53_examiner.tn: Ela tlhoko Mokgweetsi. Kafa tlase ga Melao ya Tsela ya Setshaba: Tlhatlhobo ya leotwana la boraro fa e le tlhano e tlhoka go netefatsa go tshwarega ga lonoka lwa kingpin, boemo jwa notlelo ya tshireletso, le sekgala se se se yong sa poleite. Go sa latele go isa go go paleng teko.
